scientific_integrity: Analytic proof provided; reproducible finite rational checker provided; novelty is the distributional count, not previously established AV+JR existence.
scientific_limitations: Independent Bernoulli approvals with one common p; probability concerns existence of some bad AV-maximizing tie, not an arbitrary tie-break rule; closed tie-break probability is given only for three candidates. Historical favorable-tie JR feasibility is already known. No independent scientific audit.
title: An exact Bernoulli tie-failure law for two-seat approval voting
